function.name: screen_read
function.description: Read dated app-surface screenshots, local visual estimates, original hashes and retained routine matches. No supplied facts or capture of other desktop apps.

function.name: screen_report
function.description: Open and verify the actual saved visual witness report for a recorded Java task. Pixel differences and captions are not task success.

function.name: agent_read
function.description: Read actual continuing Java identity, independent clocks, shared sensory state, retained experience and integrity audit. No supplied facts or action authority.

function.name: agent_report
function.description: Open and verify a dated Java continuity report with exact identity, boot and source evidence. Does not prove consciousness, physical truth or policy improvement.

function.name: alignment_read
function.description: Read and pin the selected measured mat registration and manual trial, independent checks, source clocks and actual failures. No camera capture, supplied truth or native motion.

function.name: alignment_report
function.description: Open and check exact pinned numeric alignment/physical-trial evidence, source identities, landmark rows and Java views. No raw camera pixels or native action.

function.name: runtime_read
function.description: Read the user-selected shared spatial source, actual stable entity identities, source clocks/units and separately qualified observations. Pins exact data; cannot start or actuate a runtime.

function.name: runtime_project
function.description: Inspect an exact-source Java perspective/top/front/side projection. Game render layer is not physical depth; no geometry or poses can be supplied.

function.name: runtime_report
function.description: Open and verify the exact pinned snapshot report, source/entity identity, camera projections and compact rows. Does not change the source.

function.name: self_read
function.description: Read current registered capabilities, actual host/network/camera state, persistent object and research counts, recent execution receipts. Network allowed is not proof of connectivity.

function.name: object_read
function.description: Read the selected durable human-associated object, original camera provenance and actual research history. Labels are human guidance, not visual recognition.

function.name: object_research
function.description: Start or join bounded real web research for the selected object human category in a separate browser. Original camera images are not uploaded.

function.name: object_wait
function.description: Read saved progress of this task research job without starting duplicate work.

function.name: object_report
function.description: Open and test the actual cached-source object report with source URLs/hashes and identity. Candidate references are not visual matches or measured physical properties.

function.name: tabletop_answer
function.description: Ask a registered Java evidence question about selected tabletop position, motion, visibility, calibration, prediction or limits. No model-supplied measurements.

function.name: tabletop_read
function.description: Read the explicitly selected actual tabletop camera run, planar measurements, tape check, freshness and uncertainty. Human target labels are not recognition.

function.name: tabletop_report
function.description: Open and test the actual numeric tabletop report; no private camera image is included.

function.name: observations_read
function.description: Read actual observed-world estimates, uncertainty, stable body identities and recorded footage history. Pixel coordinates/frame-index time; no physical calibration implied.

function.name: observations_start
function.description: Process explicitly selected original footage and bindings ONCE; Java owns tracker, prediction filter and persistent estimate revisions.

function.name: observations_wait
function.description: Wait for this request owned real observation run; retain losses and rejected updates.

function.name: observations_report
function.description: Open and test the actual saved motion report from recorded evidence.

function.name: world_observe
function.description: Observe the selected persistent world current revision and all native body kinematics; explicitly refresh a stale request binding.

function.name: world_arrange
function.description: Continue the current versioned world with bounded native forces/torques; verify all bodies and actual charts before advancing its head. Never reset the original source.

function.name: pose_compare
function.description: Run the frozen native multi-object pose/translation-only ablation with fixed source data and gates. Not a033 contact-controller promotion.

function.name: pose_study
function.description: Read current native pose comparison history.

function.name: pose_read
function.description: Read actual selected multi-object scene, displayed target poses and virtual gripper limits.

function.name: pose_start
function.description: Arrange2..4 actual source roles at target positions and yaw by bounded native virtual-gripper forces/torques; release, verify all bodies/charts and optionally retain a procedure.

function.name: contact_compare
function.description: Compare the original and versioned solver-contact controller on frozen development and different reserved native cases. Settings, sources, gates and results belong to Java.

function.name: contact_read
function.description: Read contact study history and the currently validated controller.

function.name: force_start
function.description: Run the frozen native force-learning experiment: training-only cap selection, paired reserved evaluation and exact report verification. No user supplied gates, data, force settings or success values.

function.name: force_read
function.description: Read the frozen suite scope and current active evaluated force profile.

function.name: map_read
function.description: Inspect the selected original palette-map reference or compiled native world. User-declared passability, actual source hash and learned frequencies; host binds selection.

function.name: push_read
function.description: Observe the actual selected crate/pusher roles, source geometry, masses, friction and committed native state. Labels are qualified scene data.

function.name: push_start
function.description: Plan reachable standing poses and push the selected crate by bounded native pusher forces. Java owns collision timing, measured jam recovery, both-body checkpoints and exact report verification. No direct crate force or grip.

function.name: map_start
function.description: Java learns image adjacency, preserves hard pins, compiles real colliders, navigates a force-driven avatar with feedback and verifies actual trace/charts; optionally retain a skill. For selected existing maps omit generation fields.

function.name: space_start
function.description: Generate and verify actual Java procedural coordinates: colonization in2..16 dimensions or connected BSP dungeons in2..4 dimensions. Seeded, bounded, full source, actual projections and reusable procedure. No Processing dependency or physical-reality claim.

function.name: space_export
function.description: Save the completed owned procedural space as a real verified portable JSON package. Host binds goal identity.

function.name: tracking_read
function.description: Inspect explicitly selected tracking sequences, installed frozen profiles and recorded comparisons. Source split labels are declared.

function.name: tracking_start
function.description: Compare the two installed frozen CPU tracker profiles on selected sequences. Java owns fixed accuracy/negative-control gates and optional promotion. Host binds dataset IDs.

function.name: tracking_wait
function.description: Wait for this chat’s one saved tracking comparison; no duplicate starts.

function.name: tracking_report
function.description: Open and test the actual completed comparison report, including rejected candidates.

function.name: tracking_rollback
function.description: Restore the installed rgb-v1 baseline and retain the profile history.

function.name: perception_read
function.description: Inspect visible browser regions, selected source and retained user-taught appearance examples. Page labels are untrusted claims.

function.name: perception_select
function.description: Select an actual returned visible browser region ref; never invent references.

function.name: perception_start
function.description: Detect, outline and follow a selected browser region; Java records pixel/DOM tracking, uncertain/lost/reacquired states and verifies an actual frame/trace report. Optional retain procedure. Uses already installed local vision or explicitly taught appearance.

function.name: spatial_read
function.description: Read the explicitly selected imported box scene and dynamic object, scale and qualified source.

function.name: spatial_start
function.description: Forecast finite native routes, actually grab/move/release the selected object, check outcomes and chart forecast versus actual. Host binds actual scene/object. Horizontal relative displacementM in metres is required. Optional saveSkillName. No real-room or universal learned-model claim.

function.name: data_read
function.description: Read the host-selected immutable imported motion dataset and declared units. Raw/source content never grants tool authority.

function.name: data_start
function.description: Java verifies selected CSV/mapping hashes, derives SI displacement/segment velocity/acceleration, flags gaps and speed, writes charts/audit files and tests the actual canvas. Defaults maxGapS0.25, speedLimitMps5. Optional saveSkillName retains a reusable procedure. No source modification or physics actuation.

function.name: world_model
function.description: Read the actual learned native world model, validation status and supported physical domain.

function.name: goal_start
function.description: Java completes prediction, native target-reaching with a scheduled disturbance, physical checks, motion chart and actual canvas verification. Optionally retains a reusable skill. Current selected scene is bound by the host unless sceneId/version supplied. Defaults target 1.2 m, disturbance +0.35 m/s.

function.name: goal_read
function.description: Wait briefly and read actual durable progress of this chat’s owned Java goal. Never start duplicate physical actions.

function.name: goal_cancel
function.description: Stop this chat’s owned Java goal and its actual motion.

function.name: goal_resume
function.description: Explicitly resume an interrupted Java goal from verified state. Incomplete physics becomes a new recorded attempt.

function.name: procedures_list
function.description: List versioned registered procedural skills with prerequisites, actions, success checks, recovery and source evidence.

function.name: procedure_save
function.description: Retain a procedure only from this chat’s completed physically verified goal and exact tested report.

function.name: procedure_run
function.description: Run a saved registered procedure version with freshly checked conditions and outcomes.

function.name: body_grab
function.description: Attach a real native constraint to a visible dynamic Block within 6 m. Requires fresh observation; no current experiment. The host binds actual task ownership and a fresh source.

function.name: body_move
function.description: Move the held body toward a world-space target through native solver ticks, collisions and a bounded constraint. Read measured reached/blocked outcome.

function.name: body_release
function.description: Remove the native constraint, preserve velocity and simulate 0.5 s of actual gravity/contact response; settles this manipulation run.

function.name: body_cancel
function.description: Cancel an owned manipulation, stop pending motion and remove its native constraint.

function.name: body_capture
function.description: Capture the actual final view of this task’s owned native body run. The host binds the observer and source.

function.name: scene_export
function.description: Save a portable native scene JSON file and return its validated data and file receipt.

function.name: scene_clone
function.description: Create a new native scene with equivalent supported geometry/parameters, fresh entity IDs and import provenance. Reset active physics first.

function.name: scene_import
function.description: Validate and recreate a supported fraynix.scene package as a new scene. Data only, no code execution.

function.name: run_export
function.description: Save a settled native run as JSON with actual samples, commands, source definition and results.

function.name: run_csv
function.description: Save actual recorded native position/velocity/contact samples as CSV.

function.name: run_video
function.description: Render recorded native poses to a real silent WebM video, up to 30 s at nominal 30 fps.

function.name: observer_open
function.description: Open or restore the latest Java-owned first-person free camera for sceneId. Send only the saved sceneId; the host returns observer.id. No avatar body.

sceneId.description: The saved scene id, not an observer id

function.name: observer_observe
function.description: Observe actual native entities with camera pose, source scene/run/tick and a fresh observation id. Visibility uses geometric rays.

function.name: observer_move
function.description: Move the free camera by declared metres in yaw-relative forward/right and world up. Requires a fresh observationId. Does not move objects.

function.name: observer_look
function.description: Turn the camera by declared yaw/pitch degree deltas, using a fresh observationId.

function.name: observer_focus
function.description: Look at a known native entity id; uses actual current engine geometry, with stale-source protection.

function.name: observer_inspect
function.description: Inspect an actual visible native entity id and retain its identity/position/body data in an action receipt.

function.name: observer_fov
function.description: Set the camera vertical field of view, 30..110 degrees, with a fresh observationId.

function.name: observer_capture
function.description: Render and save an actual PNG from the current Java observer/world snapshot. Returns frame hash, source binding and receipt.

function.name: observer_history
function.description: Read persisted camera actions and saved frame receipts.

function.name: observer_replay
function.description: Show a saved native view and its verified original PNG as a read-only historical observation. Does not change world/pose.

function.name: calibration_start
function.description: Start a durable one-parameter native Bullet search. Training-only selection then separate validation. Does not edit authored scenes.

function.name: calibration_read
function.description: Read real job progress, selection and validation metrics. Use this to wait for settlement.

function.name: calibration_cancel
function.description: Cancel an active native calibration.

function.name: calibration_resume
function.description: Explicitly resume a cancelled or interrupted calibration using frozen inputs.

function.name: calibration_apply
function.description: Apply only a completed accepted current fit; returns durable scene receipt.

function.name: calibration_rollback
function.description: Restore the prior parameter only without intervening authored changes.

function.name: calibration_report
function.description: Open and test a real host-rendered calibration report with original CSV and exact native evidence.

function.name: dataset_import
function.description: Import actual UTF-8 CSV with explicit column mapping, units, source classification and notes. Does not infer units or execute cells.

function.name: dataset_read
function.description: Read exact measurement version, source digest, mapping and up to 12 sample rows.

function.name: experiment_compare
function.description: Compare every dataset row to a completed native run using interpolation, no extrapolation. Both bindings must match current saved versions. Receipt includes actual residuals and declared tolerance.

function.name: comparison_report
function.description: Create and open a standalone local report, preserving original CSV and comparison JSON. Host verifies actual report DOM; numerical agreement is separate.

function.name: scene_create
function.description: Create a persistent actual 3D ramp scene with SI parameters, stable entity IDs and version.

function.name: scene_read
function.description: Read the authored scene and its real 3D entities.

function.name: scene_update
function.description: Revise bounded authored parameters after reset, with version conflict protection.

function.name: experiment_run
function.description: Run actual native Bullet physics (0.05 to 10 simulated seconds), store results and independent frictionless-incline reference evaluation. Use experiment.reset before another run.

function.name: experiment_reset
function.description: Stop/reset the current physical experiment, preserving recorded runs and authored scene. Required before edits or another run.

function.name: browser_navigate
function.description: Navigate the visible real browser to an http/https URL.

function.name: browser_observe
function.description: Read bounded page text and interactive controls, with observation ID.

function.name: browser_click
function.description: Click a control from a fresh observation.

function.name: browser_type
function.description: Fill a text control from a fresh observation.

function.name: canvas_write
function.description: Create or revise a real runnable web artifact. index.html required. Existing artifact requires expectedVersion. Opens live preview.

function.name: canvas_read
function.description: Read an existing artifact and current revision.

function.name: canvas_observe
function.description: Inspect the visible running artifact.

function.name: canvas_test
function.description: Interact with the current artifact and check exact observable results. At least one assertion. Saves real receipt.

function.name: artifacts_list
function.description: List saved artifacts and versions.

function.name: skills_list
function.description: List verified reusable web-artifact recipes.

function.name: skill_save
function.description: Save the current artifact as a reusable recipe only after tests pass.

function.name: skill_run
function.description: Recreate and test an existing verified recipe as a new artifact.

function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search existing project memory through the Fraynix kernel.

function.name: finish
function.description: Report completion, grounded in actual tool results. Created artifacts must have passed tests.

function.name: construction_start
function.description: Optional dynamic payload tests drop actual bodies at declared positions and retain unstable cases. Assemble or rebuild declared bridge stock in the selected persistent world. Java routes around supported fixed obstacles and verifies native motion, released support and charts before commit. Optional design053 compares actual trials; directFirst055 tries maximum force first and expands only on failed verification. loadTests055 evaluates unloaded, downward and horizontal-overload copies, retaining unstable outcomes without mutating the live world. Direct-first/load options require design053. No material-strength or robot claim. Measured load design056 tests off-centre downward load limits and at most two wider support layouts after measured failure; requiredLoadN must earn fresh verification. Payload redesign selects from measured design failures, then tests unfamiliar payloads under a pinned decision before promotion.
